ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity (near-black) pixels to high-intensity (white/yellow) pixels. The ventral surface is >90% dark-toned with sparse high-intensity points and localized clusters at the extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The primary fluke surface is a contiguous solid dark-grey to black region. Two distinct, high-contrast yellowish-white clusters are mapped to the distal lateral tips of both lobes. Small, isolated circular white clusters are scattered across the mid-section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped median notch with an estimated internal angle of 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/8th of the total vertical lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations along the entire trailing boundary. A prominent large-amplitude semi-circular notch is extracted from the upper-third quadrant of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The lateral boundaries exhibit a strong convex sweep from the peduncle attachment to the tips, creating a characteristic fan-shaped 2D profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive high-contrast pixel clusters at the lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization. Approximately 8-10 small, isolated circular white clusters are detected on the central-left lobe area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, parallel, diagonal light-grey linear streaks (approx. 50-100 pixels in length) are visible on the mid-region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular indentation/notch on the trailing edge of the right lobe; dense barnacle encrustations covering the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme concentration of barnacle clusters on the dorsal-facing tips that wrap around to the ventral view is highly characteristic.
